name: Minnesota Youth Institute (MNYI)
org: University of Minnesota College of Food, Agricultural and Natural Resource Sciences
what_you_do: Students write a research paper on a global food security problem and present their ideas at a one day event on the St. Paul campus. Top presenters may go to the Global Youth Institute in Iowa.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 who live in Minnesota.
pay_detail: Free. Participants are eligible for a $1,000 CFANS scholarship.
duration: Paper due early April; event on one day in May
deadline_text: 2026: register by March 27, paper due April 3, event May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up on the online form. Pick a topic and write the paper. Send it in with the permission form.
